title: Friday main service
where: National Evangelical Church in Kuwait, Kuwait City
blurb: The whole church together. Communion on the first Friday of the month.

title: Tuesday prayer meeting
blurb: An hour of prayer for the church, the network and the nation. Come late if your shift ends late.

title: Membership class
when: Fridays in September · after the service
blurb: Four sessions on what FLCC believes and what belonging here means.

title: Couples and singles evening
blurb: One evening on relationships across a distance — for married couples apart from their spouse, and for anyone single and tired of being asked about it.

title: Men's breakfast
blurb: Food, one short talk, and honest conversation. Numbers are capped at twenty so it stays a conversation.

title: BOTR network conference
blurb: All fourteen FLCC churches together for three days of teaching and worship. Registration opens in October.
